name: Define the piece visual direction
criteria: Visual direction follows the saved production method, selected original concept, recognition anchors, and approved identity/reference files

Method plan identifies method/tool, provider/module/access route and model when exposed per stage; Higgsfield is the default media pipeline, explicit user choices prevail, and integrated assistant images require an explicit alternative choice
Method plan recorded as a run input or planning output with its path and SHA-256
Exact approved visual references are planned as actual attachments; voice, animation, video, and lip-sync use verified capabilities suited to need, quality, and known cost
Assumptions, known costs, and limitations identified; unavailable required stages remain pending with alternatives, and paid external generation requires applicable authorization
No silent method substitution or stage omission; changing a requested method requires an explicit user decision and recorded replanning
